name: x-t5-first
about: First guided session: the recipe settings in IMAGE QUALITY SETTING, then common AF and shooting settings. Order matters: COLOR and CLARITY come before ACROS and HEIF, which make them unavailable.

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > FILM SIMULATION: REALA ACE
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > GRAIN EFFECT > ROUGHNESS: STRONG, then SIZE: LARGE
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > COLOR CHROME FX BLUE: STRONG
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > SMOOTH SKIN EFFECT: WEAK
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > WHITE BALANCE > COLOR TEMPERATURE: 5000K. Press MENU/OK on the shift grid without moving it.
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > WHITE BALANCE > AUTO. On the shift grid set R: +3 and B: -2, then press MENU/OK.

0xd00b.name: WhiteBalanceShiftR
0xd00b.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > WHITE BALANCE > shift R

0xd00c.name: WhiteBalanceShiftB
0xd00c.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > WHITE BALANCE > shift B

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > TONE CURVE. The screen shows two numbers beside the curve: H (highlights) and S (shadows). Change both on this one screen: move H up until it reads H +2, then move S down until it reads S -1. Press MENU/OK once to save both.
steps.note: If TONE CURVE is grey, D RANGE PRIORITY is on: change nothing, close the menu and click Skip.

0xd320.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > TONE CURVE > HIGHLIGHTS

0xd321.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > TONE CURVE > SHADOWS

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > HIGH ISO NR: -3
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > FILM SIMULATION: ACROS (plain ACROS, no filter)
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > MONOCHROMATIC COLOR: WARM +3 (WC), MAGENTA -2 (MG)
steps.note: Expects ACROS from the step before. If the grid labels differ, set the horizontal axis to +3 and the vertical axis to -2.

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > SELECT JPEG/HEIF: HEIF

steps.note: Decodes the 1/2 ON/OFF convention for about a dozen unnamed codes.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > NUMBER OF FOCUS POINTS: 425 POINTS (17 x 25)
MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > SHUTTER TYPE: ELECTRONIC SHUTTER
steps.note: The value is unknown: the step records whatever D304 becomes.
